location_description:
Monmouth Beach is a borough in Monmouth County, New Jersey, United States. As of the 2010 United States Census, the borough's population was 3,279, reflecting a decline of 316 (−8.8%) from the 3,595 counted in the 2000 Census, which had in turn increased by 292 (+8.8%) from the 3,303 counted in the 1990 Census.


== History ==
The area was first settled in 1668 and grew into a community with the arrival of the Long Branch and Sea Shore Railroad.Many early residents were professional fishermen with Norwegian backgrounds.Monmouth Beach was incorporated as a borough on March 9, 1906, by an act of the New Jersey Legislature, when it was created from portions of Ocean Township.
